title: Asɛnnibea Akyidi
intro: Wɔ tumidi akwan so no, onipa bi a ɔwɔ dibea a ɛkorɔn ani gyee akoa bi a n’ahoɔfɛ yɛ wiase foforo de ho. Saa akɔnnɔ yi de nsɛm a esisii toatoa so a ɛbɛsɔ nokwaredi ahwɛ, ada nokware ahorow a ahintaw adi, na awiei koraa no asi so dua sɛ akoa no ho nni asɛm no bae.
clues: Na mete Nil asase so, ahemfie bi a na ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnso kɛse mu.
Aberanteɛ bi baa me fie, na n’anim no maa me wiase no yɛɛ basaa.
Mebɔɔ mmɔden sɛ mɛdaadaa no, nanso ɔhwehwɛɛ guankɔbea wɔ n’Awurade mu.
Metetew n’atade mu fii n’akyi, nanso adanse no kyerɛɛ me nnaadaa.
Nea ɛbɛyɛ na mmea anuonyamfo no nsɛmmɔne ayɛ komm no, metoo nsa frɛɛ wɔn kɔɔ nhyiam bi ase na mede nneɛma a ano yɛ nnam guu wɔn nsam.
Awiei koraa no, mekaa me mfomso wɔ baguam, na migyee nokware no toom wɔ ɔhene no anim.

trial.answer: Ɔbɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛdaadaa Ɔkɔmhyɛni Yusuf

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
